records.cueHe: אמר רב איקא בריה דרב אמי
records.about: most animals bear something that can be consecrated as a firstborn, and a minority bear a נדמה, which cannot

records.cueHe: וכל היולדות יולדות מחצה זכרים ומחצה נקבות
records.about: completing the reason the mishna permits the placenta: joining the minority of נדמה to the half that are female leaves consecrable males a minority
